import unreal
S='/Game/SSPR_Validation/NS_SSPR_ProjTest.NS_SSPR_ProjTest'
E='ProjParticles'
M='SSPR_WriteOccupancy'
svc=unreal.NiagaraScratchPadService
for node in svc.list_nodes(S,E,M):
    print('NODE=' + repr((str(node.node_type),str(node.node_id),str(node.title))))
    if str(node.node_type)=='MapGet':
        print('MAPGET_PINS=' + repr([(str(x.pin_name),str(x.direction),str(x.type_name)) for x in svc.get_node_pins(S,E,M,str(node.node_id))]))
print('CONNECTIONS=' + repr([(str(x.from_node_id),str(x.from_pin),str(x.to_node_id),str(x.to_pin)) for x in svc.list_connections(S,E,M)]))
